subject: Next steps for vendor procurement enrollment — marketplace SKU mapping
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Orion Solutions <vendor-support@orionsolutions.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment kickoff — marketplace onboarding and PO routing

Hi team,

Welcome — excited to start Orion Solutions' vendor enrollment for the Redwood marketplace program. To get the procurement path and marketplace listing moving, can you please confirm the following by EOD Wednesday: 

- Primary procurement contact we should route POs to (name, email, billing entity)
- Preferred marketplace to onboard first (AWS / Azure / GCP) and any existing account IDs
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached) + W-9 or equivalent tax docs
- Any special invoicing or PO reference requirements (e.g., SOW numbers)

I've attached the onboarding form to this thread. Once we have the billing entity and PO routing, Finance (cc'd) will issue our PO template and we can start the marketplace SKU mapping and plan the listing timeline.

Attachments: [Attachment: Orion_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)]

Next steps from Redwood after you return the form:
- Finance confirms PO acceptance and billing entity
- Marketplaces team (Vanessa) creates a vendor profile and pre-populates SKU mapping
- We send the MSA via DocuSign for signature (if not already executed)

Thanks — short responses are fine, we just need the contact and preferred marketplace to schedule the onboarding window.

Best,
Irene Choi
Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123
From: Orion Solutions <vendor-support@orionsolutions.com>

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment kickoff — marketplace onboarding and PO routing

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the note — Orion here. Quick answers below: 

- Procurement contact: Maya R. Patel, Director of Finance — maya.patel@orionsolutions.com (primary)
- Billing entity: Orion Solutions, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789)
- Preferred marketplace: Azure Marketplace first, then AWS. We have an existing Microsoft Partner ID and can provide the ID after you confirm the vendor profile fields you need.
- Invoicing: Please include PO number and Redwood account name on invoices. We can accept POs sent to procure@orionsolutions.com.

We've attached our corporate terms and will complete the vendor onboarding form this afternoon. Two quick Qs: 1) Any specific SKU naming convention you require for the marketplace listing? 2) Does Redwood accept consolidated monthly invoicing for marketplace fees?

Attachments: [Attachment: Orion_Corp_Terms.pdf (application/pdf)]

—Samira (on behalf of Maya)
Orion Solutions — Vendor Operations

Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment kickoff — marketplace onboarding and PO routing

Irene / Vanessa — thanks. A couple internal finance asks before we send PO template to Orion: 

- Confirm the legal billing name and remit address (we need the exact address to populate the PO).
- Do we need to route POs to a purchase ledger code (PL code)? If so please advise the PL code.

Vanessa, can you also confirm the SKU mapping requirements for Azure Marketplace (short code vs. full SKU string)? I'll attach our PO template for Orion to review and confirm acceptance.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment kickoff — marketplace onboarding and PO routing

Thanks everyone — short plan from Marketplaces side: 

1) Vendor profile creation: I'll create Orion's vendor record in our portal and request their Microsoft Partner ID and Azure listing metadata.
2) SKU mapping: For Azure Marketplace we prefer short product codes (e.g., ORN-CORE-001) that we translate into the marketplace SKU. I'll share our SKU template after I get the partner ID.
3) PO flow: Laura — Redwood accepts the attached PO template. Orion confirmed invoices should reference PO + Redwood account name. Finance will issue POs to procure@orionsolutions.com.
4) Contracts: If you don't have a signed MSA we will send via DocuSign. Link below.

Action items and links: 
- Orion: please return the completed onboarding form + W-9 and confirm partner ID (target: 8/7)
- Laura: issue the PO after we confirm billing address (target: 8/9)
- Vanessa: create vendor profile and provide SKU template (target: 8/8)

Marketplace links for onboarding: 
- Azure onboarding guide: https://marketplace.redwood.ai/docs/azure-onboard
- DocuSign MSA: https://www.docusign.net/Redwood-MSA/ABCD1234

Attachments referenced: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx, Redwood_MSA_DocuSign.link

Thanks — planning to schedule a 30m sync with Maya if needed. Marcus, would you take point on legal redlines if any?

Vanessa Ortiz
Head, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
